Do these providers sell a hosted compute sandbox or hosted compute capacity? For each, add a record with its price, free tier and identity cost, or record why it is not an offer.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/watasu-sandboxes $.verdict: No free runtime: creation needs a balance above zero (card top-ups from EUR 5). docs/conventions defines paid-only as never free; the record own free_tier.stated says there is no free runtime, so qualifies-with-caveat contradicts it.
- compute/kosem $.verdict: Credits are a one-off $10 for 60 days, not renewing: that is trial-only, not qualifies-with-caveat.
- compute/avrea-sandboxes $.identity_cost.kind: Sign-in page offers only GitHub and SSO; no email path shown, so identity kind email is not supported (github/SSO).
- compute/chalk-compute-sandboxes $.identity_cost.kind: Signup capture (re-read fresh, same hash) shows no field or text naming email; identity not stated.
